manifest.name: Illustrative EOD research lab
manifest.source: Deterministic synthetic fixtures; not actual NSE/BSE prices
manifest.license_reference: Synthetic test data generated by this project
manifest.notes: Fictional weekday calendar and constituents. Index labels identify calculation roles, not real constituent coverage.

backtest.method: Next-session open; one entry per structural episode; gross dividend receivables without reinvestment; split/bonus share accounting. Drawdown is worst individual close-marked trade, not a portfolio equity curve. Source completeness is user-attested, not independently certified.
